byPath.*: Decides the monthly food assistance of a household: counted income, deductions, the gross, net and asset tests, the benefit, and the documents still missing
byPath.AssetTest: The asset limit and the asset test
byPath.Benefit: The maximum benefit minus 30% of the net income, with a minimum for small households
byPath.Eligibility: The missing documents, the outcome of every test and the status ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE or PENDING
byPath.Household: A household application: the application date, the housing costs, the assets and the members
byPath.HouseholdFacts: The size, the counted gross and earned income, the elderly or disabled flag and the housing costs of the household
byPath.IncomeTest: The gross income test, the deductions, the net income and the net income test
byPath.Member: One household member: name, birth date, disability, student status and monthly income
byPath.MemberFacts: The age of the member, whether the member is elderly or a student child, and the income that counts
byPath.assessHousehold: Assesses a household application: status, monthly benefit, tests, missing documents and the income calculation
byPath.familyBook: A family of four with one working parent, one parent with a pension and a working student child
byPath.incompleteBook: An elderly couple whose application has no assets and no birth date for one member
byPath.maximumBenefit: The maximum monthly benefit by household size
byPath.povertyLine: The monthly poverty line by household size
byPath.programRules: The parameters of the program: limits, deduction rates, the shelter cap and the minimum benefit
byPath.standardDeduction: The standard deduction by household size
byPath.testOutcome: PASSED, FAILED, or UNKNOWN when the evidence for a test is missing
